task.question: Which World Cup stage did South Africa advance to for the first time following their group stage victory over South Korea?
task.evidence: With a 1–0 victory, South Africa qualified for the knockout stages of a World Cup for the first time, as runners-up of Group A

answer:
South Africa advanced to the knockout stage for the first time following their group stage victory over South Korea in the 2010 FIFA World Cup. 

FINAL: Round of 16.
